GNIOT Group of Institutions (GNIOT) is the brainchild of the visionary industrialist, Late Shri Krishan Lal Gupta, the founder of the group. He has distinguished himself through his signiﬁcant contributions to business, academics, research, government, and society at large.
GNIOT Institute of Management Studies (GIMS), Greater Noida, offers Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) approved by A.I.C.T.E and Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. PGDM is the ﬂagship program of GNIOT Group which opens a new world of opportunities for the students. Our emphasis is on holistic development of the students. Interdisciplinary G approach is implemented in the teaching-learning process and research. At GIMS, our endeavour is to treat every student as an individual, to recognize their potential and to ensure that they receive the best preparation and training for achieving their career ambitions and life goals. We aim at producing not only good professionals but also good and worthy citizens of a great country, aiding in its overall progress and development.

The programme offers Dual Specialization in the second year. The pedagogical methods for teaching are lectures, case studies, project work and simulations. These methods are further augmented by online certiﬁcation programs from different providers, group discussions, role-plays, movie screenings and industrial visits.
